what_this_is: WP-D5 retrieval corpus. One record per MetaInsight candidate that survives twin-merge, wide by design (D42 ruling 3): the ranked cut and the 32-finding feed are marked, not selected for. Every sentence is phase5_ranking.generate_nl_summary -- nothing here computes, re-reads or rewrites a figure. Vectors live beside this file in retrieval_corpus.npy, row-aligned with `records`.
